title: World BEYOND War Canada chapter and public-person expansion

sources.title: World BEYOND War Who We Are

summary: Expanded the existing World BEYOND War seed into six current first-party-listed Canadian chapters, two explicit public organizer/coordinator people, and three exact first-party-linked Toronto social accounts.

provenance.method: bounded current first-party chapter expansion with repository deduplication

classification_rules: Treat current first-party Canada chapter listings as explicit local_chapter_of evidence.
Preserve each named Canadian chapter as a distinct organization.
Treat Rachel Small and Helen Peacock roles as explicit public roles from first-party pages.
Treat Toronto social accounts as canonical public accounts only because the current first-party chapter page links them directly.
data.method: Follow the unresolved World BEYOND War Canada chapter-network edge from the prior Africa expansion; enumerate the six current first-party Canada chapters; deduplicate names against repository search; cross-enumerate explicit public staff/coordinator roles and exact Toronto social accounts.
data.narrative_role: bounded chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion investigator
data.research_question: Which current World BEYOND War Canadian chapters, public organizer roles, and directly linked public accounts can be materialized from first-party structure pages?

findings.finding: World BEYOND War's current Canada page lists six Canadian chapters: Montréal, Victoria, Pivot2Peace South Georgian Bay, High School Peace and Justice Club Manitoba, Toronto, and Vancouver.
World BEYOND War's current staff page identifies Rachel Small as Canada Organizer.
First-party South Georgian Bay materials identify Helen Peacock as chapter coordinator.
The current Toronto chapter page directly links Instagram @torontowbw, Facebook wbwtoronto, and Twitter/X @TorontoWBW.
